g.text: Strong entities: DEPARTMENT, STUDENT, SKILL, COMPANY, JOB, APPLICATION, PLACEMENT, USER (own primary key; role = officer or student). Weak entity: INTERVIEW_ROUND (double box) - identified by APPLICATION + partial key round_no.

Double diamond = identifying relationship. Thick line = total participation. Underlined = primary key, dashed underline = partial key. M:N relationships (has skill, requires) become tables student_skills and job_skills.
